title: The Insurance Ecosystem: How Your Premium Travels From Policyholder to Reinsurer
summary: Traces the journey of premium capital across the global risk distribution hierarchy: direct retail brokers and InsurTech MGAs (like JA Assure), primary insurance carriers, Lloyd's of London syndicates, reinsurance giants, and retrocessionaires who protect the ultimate solvency of the financial system.
key_facts: Managing General Agents (MGAs): JA Assure acts as a specialized InsurTech MGA with delegated underwriting authority from global syndicates.
Reinsurance backing: complex risks (Specie, Medical Malpractice) are supported by global treaty capacity.
Risk transfer: premiums pool globally to absorb catastrophic single-event losses.
